policy: Read-only external vocabulary and terminology. Zelle question-records.json remains authoritative for approved answers.

sources.purpose: Creative vocabulary for recognizing art media, themes, emotions, and symbols
Canonical source-attributed definitions, creative vocabulary, related terms and source-provided bilingual word pairs
sources.trust: source-attributed unreviewed reference; distinguish creative terms from definitions and draft translations from reviewed translations

sources.purpose: Shared browser translation and dictionary lookup API; integrate via a tested adapter, not by treating JS as JSON

notes: Never treat vocabulary words as approved conversational answers.
No cross-repository write access is granted.
Cross-origin browser fetch requires compatible deployment and CORS; test before enabling live retrieval.
Academy dictionary has a canonical JSON and a separate offline bundle; verify bundle parity before deployment.
Never silently treat source-listed related terms as certified synonyms or draft phrase pairs as verified translations.
